title: JA Essence wp7 1.0.7: field focus, forms, menu drawer, fixed widgets and header icon controls behave and look like the Joomla source
steps: S1: A WordPress site running the wp-ja-essence theme under test (local stand restored from the quickstart pack) and the Joomla source (local stand from quickstart/ja-essence/j6, with its web fonts: the typography of the template style must be set, or every text width shifts).

S2: From the TCH checkout run: node vendor/wordpress/tracy-wordpress-theme/skills/tracy-wordpress-theme/scripts/visual/site-sweep.mjs --site <site> --source <source> --run-root tasks/ja-essence-wp7 --zip <theme.zip> --only overflow,scheme,background,header,chips,fixed-widgets,icons,forms,text,first-interaction --concurrency 4 --reload --out <dir> (about 10-17 minutes).

S3: Run: node tasks/ja-essence-wp7/tools/measure106.mjs --site <site> --source <source> --sweep <dir>/fix-measure.json --zip <theme.zip> --out <file>, then node tasks/ja-essence-wp7/tools/measure107.mjs --site <site> --source <source> --base <file> --zip <theme.zip> --routes <json list of the 31 routes> --out <fix-measure.json> (header icons by selector: ink colour and place).
S4: Run tasks/ja-essence-wp7/tools/measure105.mjs --only A1,A2,A3,A4,A5,A6 as the regression group.
expect: site-sweep: overflow, scheme, background, header, chips, fixed-widgets, forms, text and first-interaction pass with 0 defects on every route; the rows the dossier records as decided (D-82, D-90, D-92, D-93) are listed as not counted.
site-sweep icons: 0 defects; the 68 cases it cannot pair (icons-unpairable) are listed as not measured and are covered by measure107.
measure107 port-header-icons: 372 cases, 0 defects (the dark ink of the mode switch, search glyph and menu button is #c2c9d6 as in the source; the painted centres are within 1.5px).
measure106: wording 2/2, slider 13/13, port-icons 3/3; measure105 A1-A6: 6/6 checks pass.
evidence: Sweeps of 05/10/2026 against a local copy of the Joomla source: baseline on the 1.0.6 restore passed 3 of 10 checks; 1.0.7 on the clean restore passes 13 of 14 targeted checks with 0 defects, the fourteenth (icons) lists 68 cases the tool cannot pair, measured by hand and by measure107
fence: Browser-measured behaviour of the shipped theme against the source; the sweep icons check is not asserted to pass because it cannot pair the header controls by name; differences recorded as decisions are not asserted to zero
